newsitem.title: ESTONIA: C.BANK MULLS TIGHTER REIGN ON SECURITIES COM.
newsitem.headline: C.BANK MULLS TIGHTER REIGN ON SECURITIES COM.

text.p: The Estonian central bank is mulling the idea of bringing the securities commission under its control to guarantee its independence, Aripaev newspaper said on Tuesday.
The Estonian central bank values highly the principle of independence, which is needed to back the inflow of foreign investments, Vahur Kraft, the president of the central bank, was quoted as saying.
The securities commission is currently responsible to the finance ministry.
The Tallinn Stock Exchange and the Estonian Securities Central Depository support the idea, saying the central bank has long-term experience and knowledge in the inspection of commercial banks.
